_readme: Bank credit-alert parsers, as DATA rather than code, so a shopkeeper can
update them without redeploying and so the community can contribute a bank
!! EVERY PATTERN BELOW IS A PLACEHOLDER. !!
No public source documents the exact body of an Indian bank's UPI credit
alert email. These were written from the shape such alerts are reported to
take, and MUST be replaced with patterns derived from real samples before
any shop takes a real payment. Run `npm run bank:selftest` (pay yourself
Rs 1) and paste the captured alert into `docs/bank-samples/` first.
Shipping a wrong pattern here does not fail loudly. It fails by never
matching, which looks exactly like 'no customer has paid yet'.

banks.name: HDFC Bank
notes: HDFC stopped SMS alerts for UPI credits under Rs 500 on 25 June 2024
while explicitly continuing EMAIL alerts for all UPI transactions.
This is the only bank for which continued email alerting on UPI credits
is confirmed from a primary source. Configure alerts via NetBanking >

banks.name: State Bank of India
notes: Sender address and body format unconfirmed.

banks.name: ICICI Bank
notes: Sender address and body format unconfirmed.

banks.name: Generic fallback
notes: Never auto-confirms. A generic-parsed alert is written to bank_credit
but flagged low-confidence, and the admin must confirm the first one
from a given sender. After a confirmation the admin UI offers to save
the learned pattern as a new bank entry.
